title: Q-RES-ashby-journal-J5: Taking from an archive what is convenient (measured 0.996, target >= 1.0)
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** research pass: ashby-journal finding J5 is not-met (measured 0.996)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation research --probe ashby-journal:J5
**Prediction:** archive_triaged_share >= 1 within 2160 h
**Out of scope:** editing the study, its target or the paper to match the code; the measurement is changed only by changing the mechanism
**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation research --probe ashby-journal:J5`
**Status:** open

Concern: Taking from an archive what is convenient. The study: Ashby's index is the map of his journal; a system that says it has incorporated the journal has to account for every entry of that map, not only the ones it liked.

Mechanisms that should answer it: ASHBY-ARCHIVE-1 (foundation/ashbyarchive.py).

Metric: share of Ashby's index keywords and Other Index categories with a disposition in doctrine/ashby-archive.json (ASHBY-ARCHIVE-1), target >= 1.0. Improve the mechanism (or add one) until the probe passes; the white paper at /research updates itself from the same measurement.
